actions.name: cross_toe_touch
actions.text: a person bends forward and touches each hand to the opposite foot alternately
paraphrases: a person twists and reaches the right hand toward the left foot, then switches
a person bends down diagonally so one hand meets the opposite toes repeatedly
a person alternately reaches each hand down across the body to the other foot
actions.motion: Starting with the feet apart and arms out, the person bends at the hips and twists the torso so the right hand reaches down to the left foot. The torso rises back up and then the left hand reaches down to the right foot. This crossing bend repeats several times on alternating sides.

phases.start: stands with feet apart and arms out
phases.middle: bends and twists so a hand reaches the opposite foot, alternating sides

confusable_with.name: pick_up
confusable_with.visible_difference: one bend straight down without twisting, then rising

confusable_with.name: put_on_a_shoe
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands stay at one foot for a while, often with that foot lifted

confusable_with.name: stretch_oneself
confusable_with.visible_difference: torso extends upward or sideways rather than bending to the feet

actions.name: side_kick
actions.text: a person lifts one leg and kicks it out sideways from the hip
paraphrases: a person extends the right leg straight out to the side and pulls it back
a person leans away and thrusts one foot sideways at hip height
a person kicks sideways with one leg while the torso tilts the other way
actions.motion: The weight shifts onto the left leg and the right knee lifts. The right leg then extends quickly out to the side with the foot leading, while the torso tilts toward the left to balance. The leg pulls back and the foot returns to the ground, sometimes repeated.

phases.start: weight shifts to one leg and the other knee lifts
phases.middle: leg extends out to the side
phases.end: leg pulls back and foot lands

confusable_with.name: kicking_something
confusable_with.visible_difference: leg swings forward rather than out to the side

confusable_with.name: kicking
confusable_with.visible_difference: foot moves forward toward a second person

confusable_with.name: hopping
confusable_with.visible_difference: supporting foot leaves the ground repeatedly and the lifted leg stays bent

actions.name: yawn
actions.text: a person raises one hand to the mouth and tilts the head back briefly
paraphrases: a person covers the mouth with the right hand while the head tips back
a person lifts a hand to the face and stretches the neck slightly upward
a person brings the right hand to the mouth with a slow backward head tilt
actions.motion: The right hand rises slowly to the front of the mouth and stays there briefly. The head tilts slightly back and the shoulders and chest may lift, sometimes with the arms stretching a little. The hand then lowers and the head returns to level.

phases.middle: hand held at the mouth with head tilted back

confusable_with.name: sneeze_cough
confusable_with.visible_difference: head and torso jerk forward and down rather than tilting back

confusable_with.name: hush
confusable_with.visible_difference: hand held still at the lips with the head staying level

confusable_with.name: blow_nose
confusable_with.visible_difference: both hands cover the nose with the head tipping forward

actions.name: stretch_oneself
actions.text: a person raises both arms overhead and extends the body upward, then relaxes
paraphrases: a person lifts both arms high above the head and lengthens the torso
a person pushes both hands upward with the chest lifting and back arching
a person reaches both arms up and outward to stretch, then lowers them
actions.motion: Both arms rise from the sides or front until they are extended above the head, often with the hands close together. The torso straightens and may lean back or to each side while the arms stay up for a moment. The arms then come down and the body relaxes.

phases.middle: arms held fully extended overhead with the torso stretched

confusable_with.name: cheer_up
confusable_with.visible_difference: arms go up quickly and may shake, without slow torso extension

confusable_with.name: capitulate
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands stop beside the head with elbows bent

confusable_with.name: yawn
confusable_with.visible_difference: one hand goes to the mouth

actions.name: blow_nose
actions.text: a person brings both hands to the nose and bends the head forward
paraphrases: a person holds both hands over the nose while tilting the head down
a person lifts both hands to the center of the face and wipes the nose
a person covers the nose with both hands and makes small pressing motions
actions.motion: Both hands rise together to the front of the face and meet at the nose. The head tips slightly forward and may jerk a little while the hands stay at the nose, sometimes with small wiping motions. The hands then lower away from the face.

phases.middle: hands held at the nose with the head tipped forward

confusable_with.name: sneeze_cough
confusable_with.visible_difference: head and torso jerk forward with a hand only briefly at the mouth

confusable_with.name: wipe_face
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands move over the whole face

confusable_with.name: yawn
confusable_with.visible_difference: one hand at the mouth and the head tilts back

actions.name: hit_with_object
actions.text: a person swings the right arm down onto another person, who flinches away
paraphrases: a person raises the arm high and strikes down at another person's body
two people face each other as one swings an arm down onto the other
a person hits another person with a downward arm swing as the partner recoils
actions.motion: The actor faces the partner, lifts the right arm high with the elbow bent, then swings it forward and down toward the partner's head or shoulder. The partner reacts by leaning or stepping back and may raise the arms to shield the head. The swing may repeat once or twice before the actor lowers the arm.

phases.start: actor raises the right arm high toward the partner
phases.middle: arm swings down onto the partner, partner recoils
phases.end: actor lowers the arm, partner shields or steps away

not_observable: the object held in the hand

confusable_with.name: punch_slap
confusable_with.visible_difference: arm moves forward in a short strike without a high overhead wind-up

confusable_with.name: wield_knife
confusable_with.visible_difference: arm makes repeated thrusting or slashing motions rather than a downward hit

confusable_with.name: pat_on_back
confusable_with.visible_difference: hand lands gently on the partner's back without a fast swing

actions.name: wield_knife
actions.text: a person thrusts the right hand repeatedly toward another person who backs away
paraphrases: a person makes stabbing or slashing arm motions at another person in front
two people face each other while one jabs an arm forward at the other
a person lunges with the right arm toward another person who retreats defensively
actions.motion: The actor holds the right hand forward at waist or chest height and makes quick thrusts or side-to-side slashes toward the partner, sometimes stepping forward. The partner leans back, steps away, and raises the arms in front of the body to block. The thrusts repeat several times.

phases.start: actor raises the right hand toward the partner
phases.middle: repeated thrusts or slashes, partner backs off with arms up
phases.end: actor pulls the arm back, partner keeps distance

confusable_with.name: punch_slap
confusable_with.visible_difference: a single strike whose hand reaches the partner's head or body

confusable_with.name: hit_with_object
confusable_with.visible_difference: a high overhead downward swing

confusable_with.name: shoot_with_gun
confusable_with.visible_difference: arm held straight and still, pointed at the partner

actions.name: knock_over
actions.text: a person pushes into another person who falls to the ground
paraphrases: a person shoves or trips another person, making the partner fall down
two people collide as one drives forward and the other drops to the floor
a person knocks another person off balance so the partner ends up lying down
actions.motion: The actor moves toward the partner and pushes with both arms or bumps with the shoulder or leg. The partner's torso tips backward or sideways, the knees bend, and the partner drops to the ground with the hip and torso ending low. The actor stays standing over the fallen partner.

phases.end: partner lies or sits on the ground, actor stands

confusable_with.name: pushing
confusable_with.visible_difference: partner only steps back and stays standing

confusable_with.name: falling_down
confusable_with.visible_difference: one person falls with no second person causing it

confusable_with.name: kicking
confusable_with.visible_difference: actor's leg swings into the partner, who usually stays upright

actions.name: grab_stuff
actions.text: a person reaches out and snatches something from another person's hands
paraphrases: a person grabs at another person's hands and pulls back quickly toward the body
two people stand close as one suddenly reaches over and takes from the other
a person yanks something away from another person, who pulls back or reaches after
actions.motion: The partner holds the hands in front of the body. The actor reaches the right arm quickly toward the partner's hands and then pulls it back sharply toward the actor's own torso. The partner's hands are pulled forward briefly and may then reach after the actor or pull back.

phases.start: partner holds hands in front, actor reaches
phases.middle: actor's hand grips and pulls back sharply
phases.end: actor holds the hand near the body, partner reacts

confusable_with.name: giving_object
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands move slowly and the partner offers with the arm extended

confusable_with.name: exchange_things
confusable_with.visible_difference: both people pass hands both ways calmly

confusable_with.name: shaking_hands
confusable_with.visible_difference: hands join and move up and down instead of being pulled away

actions.name: shoot_with_gun
actions.text: a person points a straight arm at another person, who raises the hands
paraphrases: a person aims the extended right arm at another person who freezes or ducks
two people face each other while one holds an arm straight out at the other
a person holds both hands forward aimed at another person, who recoils
actions.motion: The actor raises the right arm, often supported by the left hand, until it points straight at the partner, and holds it still with small backward jerks. The partner reacts by raising both hands, flinching, falling, or turning away. The actor's arm stays aimed for a while before lowering.

phases.start: actor lifts the arm toward the partner
phases.middle: arm held straight and aimed with small recoil jerks, partner reacts
phases.end: actor lowers the arm, partner has raised hands or fallen

confusable_with.name: point_finger
confusable_with.visible_difference: arm points but there is no recoil and the partner shows little reaction

confusable_with.name: capitulate
confusable_with.visible_difference: a single person raises both hands with no one aiming

confusable_with.name: wield_knife
confusable_with.visible_difference: arm thrusts repeatedly rather than being held still
